job.title: Senior Legal Counsel - Product, Privacy & Regulatory
job.description:
PQE Partners are working with a scale up technology business looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel to its Sydney legal team.

This is a highly autonomous role sitting at the intersection of product development, privacy, data and emerging regulation, supporting a business developing and scaling technology products globally.

Rather than operating as a traditional advisory function, Legal works closely with Product and Engineering as products are being developed. The successful candidate will be expected to get involved early – understanding what the business is trying to achieve, identifying potential legal and regulatory constraints and helping teams find practical ways forward.

The role offers a broad remit and significant exposure to senior stakeholders, while remaining hands-on and closely connected to the day-to-day development of the business.

In this role, you will:
  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle, from initial ideation and design through to launch and ongoing development.
  • Advise on privacy, data protection and data governance issues across new and existing products.
  • Help embed privacy and regulatory considerations into product design and development.
  • Advise on emerging regulatory issues across areas such as payments, financial services, digital assets, AML/CTF, sanctions, online safety and AI.
  • Work through novel legal questions where regulation may be evolving and provide clear, practical recommendations to the business.
  • Support broader commercial and corporate matters where required, working as part of a lean legal function.
  • Build strong relationships across Product, Engineering, Growth and other business teams.
  • Work directly with senior executives on strategic projects, new initiatives and areas of legal or regulatory risk.
  • Contribute to legal processes, systems and ways of working as the function continues to develop.
You will be an experienced lawyer with a background in technology, fintech, digital platforms or another product-led and regulated environment.

Of particular interest will be candidates with:
  • Strong product legal experience and a track record of working directly with Product and/or Engineering teams.
  • Experience getting involved during product ideation and design, rather than primarily providing legal review immediately before launch.
  • Good knowledge of privacy and data, with the confidence to take ownership of complex matters.
  • Exposure to regulatory issues affecting technology or digital products.
  • Experience working in a fast-moving environment where priorities change and lawyers are expected to operate with a high degree of independence.
  • Strong commercial judgement and an ability to give a clear recommendation rather than simply identify legal risk.
  • The confidence to work with and influence senior stakeholders.
  • A practical, curious and solutions-focused approach.
You do not need to bring deep expertise across every area of regulation relevant to the business. The team is particularly interested in lawyers who have a strong foundation across product and privacy/data, combined with the ability to quickly get across unfamiliar or emerging issues.

Similarly, previous experience within this particular industry is not required. Relevant backgrounds could include technology, fintech, payments, SaaS, digital platforms, marketplaces or other businesses where lawyers work closely with teams developing and launching products.

The legal function is intentionally lean, providing significant ownership and visibility across the business. This would particularly suit someone who enjoys being close to Product and Engineering, operating with autonomy and working through complex issues where the answer isn't always black and white.
There is also scope for the role to grow as the business and legal function continue to develop.

A competitive remuneration package including long-term incentives is available, alongside hybrid working from the Sydney CBD office.

job.title: Legal Counsel / Senior Legal Counsel
job.description:
PQE Partners are working with a leading financial services organisation looking to appoint a financial markets lawyer to its Sydney legal team.
  
The role sits within a specialist team supporting a sophisticated financial markets business, with a focus on the negotiation and management of trading and financing documentation.
  
The team is open to candidates from 4+ PQE through to a significantly more senior level, with the scope and responsibilities tailored to the experience of the successful candidate.
  
There is also flexibility around how the role is structured, with permanent or contract arrangements and full-time or part-time hours all open for consideration.
  
Working closely with legal and business stakeholders, you will:
  • Negotiate and advise on financial markets documentation, including ISDA Master Agreements, CSAs and prime financing documentation.
  • Advise on contractual and credit risk issues across derivatives, securities and financing transactions.
  • Work closely with front office, risk, credit and operational stakeholders.
  • Support the development and improvement of documentation templates, playbooks and processes.
  • Monitor relevant regulatory developments and advise on their practical impact.
  • Contribute to process improvement, technology and automation initiatives.
  
You will be a qualified lawyer with relevant financial markets experience gained within a bank, financial institution or leading law firm.
  
Ideally, you will bring:
  • Experience negotiating financial markets documentation, particularly ISDA/CSA and/or prime financing documentation.
  • Knowledge of derivatives, securities lending and/or prime financing.
  • An understanding of the Australian financial services regulatory environment.
  • Strong drafting, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • A commercial and pragmatic approach.
  
You do not need experience across every product area. Of greater importance is a strong grounding in financial markets documentation and the ability to develop across a broader product suite.
  
The legal team is lean and closely embedded with the business, giving lawyers direct exposure to key stakeholders and the commercial context behind the documentation they are negotiating.
  
There is strong technical expertise within the team and a genuine opportunity to learn from experienced financial markets lawyers, while also contributing to how the documentation function develops as the business grows.
  
Given the flexibility around seniority, employment structure and working hours, the team is open-minded about what the right appointment looks like and will shape the role around the experience of the successful candidate.

job.title: Head of Legal - Product, Privacy & Regulatory
job.description:
PQE Partners are working with a leading global technology business looking to appoint a Head of Legal to its Sydney team.

This is a broad, senior legal role with primary responsibility across Product, Privacy and Regulatory, alongside oversight of wider legal matters across the business.

The organisation operates globally in a fast-moving, highly innovative sector and is continuing to invest in new technology, data and analytics products. The legal team is lean and closely embedded with Product, Engineering and senior leadership, giving the Head of Legal significant autonomy and direct exposure to key decision-makers.

A major focus of the role will be working with Product and Engineering from the early stages of product development – helping the business understand what it can build, navigating complex legal and regulatory issues and influencing product design and strategy rather than simply reviewing products at launch.
Working closely with the executive team and stakeholders globally, you will:
  • Lead legal support across Product, Privacy and Regulatory matters.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering from ideation and design through to development, launch and ongoing operation.
  • Advise on complex privacy, data protection and data governance issues, including privacy-by-design.
  • Navigate a broad range of regulatory matters which may include payments, financial services, digital assets, AML/CTF, sanctions, online safety and AI.
  • Provide clear, commercial advice on new products, technologies and business models where the regulatory position may be evolving or uncertain.
  • Advise on broader commercial, corporate and operational legal matters as required.
  • Work closely with founders, executives and senior stakeholders on strategic legal and risk issues.
  • Help shape the legal function, including its structure, processes and future growth.
You will be an experienced lawyer with a strong background advising technology or other product-led businesses.

Ideally, you will bring:
  • Genuine product legal experience, with evidence of working directly with Product and Engineering during the ideation and design stages of technology products.
  • Strong privacy and data experience, with the ability to personally own complex issues rather than relying on specialist support.
  • Broader regulatory experience gained within technology, fintech, financial services, digital platforms or another highly regulated environment.
  • Experience operating within a fast-growth, scale-up or similarly dynamic business where you have needed to work autonomously and across a broad remit.
  • The confidence and judgement to give clear, pragmatic advice where there may not be an obvious legal or regulatory answer.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders.
  • A hands-on approach and willingness to move between strategic issues and the detail when required.
You do not need to be an expert across every regulatory area, nor do you need previous experience within the organisation's specific sector. Of greater importance is a strong grounding in product, privacy and data, combined with the ability to quickly understand emerging regulatory issues and translate them into practical commercial advice.

This is not a traditional, highly structured Head of Legal role. The legal team is lean, the business moves quickly and the successful candidate will need to be comfortable operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity.

In return, there is genuine scope to influence both the direction of the business and the development of the legal function, with direct exposure to founders and senior leadership and the opportunity to help shape and grow the team over time.

The business offers a highly competitive remuneration package, including long-term incentives, alongside hybrid working from its Sydney CBD office.

job.title: Senior Associate - Commercial Litigation & Insolvency
job.description:
Associate / Senior Associate – Commercial Litigation & Insolvency
PQE Partners are exclusively representing a growing boutique law firm that continues to build strong momentum in the market. Having partnered with the firm on multiple successful hires, including at Senior Associate level, we have seen first-hand the quality of work, leadership and trajectory of the practice.
  
Following continued growth and an increasing pipeline of complex matters, the firm is now seeking to add another high-calibre litigator to its team. This is a genuine opportunity to join a practice that is scaling in a considered way, with strong foundations already in place.
  
Key Responsibilities
As Associate / Senior Associate, you will work closely with the firm’s founders and play a key role in advising clients across a broad range of disputes, including but not limited to:
  • Complex commercial litigation matters, including debt recovery disputes
  • Insolvency and restructuring litigation, acting for a range of stakeholders
  • High-stakes disputes for corporate clients, SMEs, and individuals
  • Supervising and mentoring junior lawyers, helping to shape the next generation of the firm’s talent
  • Developing client relationships and originating new matters, with support from the partners
  
About You
The ideal candidate will be a Senior Associate or a strong Associate ready to step up, with:
  • 4+ years’ post-admission experience in commercial litigation and/or insolvency
  • The ability to run matters with increasing autonomy
  • A commercial mindset and confidence dealing directly with clients
  • Strong advocacy and drafting skills
  • An interest in being part of a growing boutique and contributing beyond pure fee-earning
  
What’s on Offer
This is a genuinely different opportunity to the traditional law firm pathway, offering:
  • A clear trajectory as the firm continues to grow, with future equity potential
  • Commission incentives on work you originate
  • Direct exposure to founders and clients from day one
  • A high-trust environment with real autonomy
  • The opportunity to join a team where recent hires have integrated quickly and are already making a tangible impact
  
If you are a commercial litigator with insolvency experience and are looking to take the next step in a growing and well-positioned firm, please contact Katie Mitchell at PQE Partners for a confidential discussion or apply directly.

job.title: Senior Associate Sydney
job.description:
PQE Partners are representing a highly regarded national commercial and property law firm, known for their deep expertise across strata and community titles, property development and litigation. As the firm continues its expansion, an opportunity has arisen for a Senior Associate to join the Sydney team.
  
This is a unique chance to work directly under highly accomplished & esteemed partner with over 20 years of experience in this area. You’ll work closely with him, and alongside some of Australia’s top practitioners in this space – on a high-quality mix of litigation, advisory, and commercial property matters.
  
Key Responsibilities
You will support across a diverse range of property-related disputes and advisory matters, including:
  • Strata and community title disputes (with a focus on Victorian legislation)
  • Property development, insurance, leasing and general property law
  • Construction disputes and broader contractual issues
  • Debt recovery and enforcement
  • Drafting legal correspondence, court documents and client advice
  • Attending court hearings and preparing materials for both interlocutory and final hearings
  • Briefing counsel and assisting with witness and expert evidence
  • Managing your own files with growing responsibility
About You
You will have at least 5+ years PQE. Strata/property experience would be highly regarded or relatable litigation experience for someone who can take direction and who is ready to learn.

You need to be ambitious and a proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

What’s on Offer
This is a standout opportunity to develop your legal career under the guidance of an exceptional leader and within a firm that is highly respected in this space. You’ll gain exposure to a wide variety of matters, enjoy structured mentorship and support, and be part of an expanding office where your contribution will be valued.

job.title: Company Secretary - ASX Listed
job.description:
About the opportunity:
Our client is seeking a Manager Company Secretary in Melbourne or Sydney to ensure the Company and compliance obligations are met for several ASX listed and private entities, whilst also managing a small team of co secs. Join a supportive team with the opportunity for clear career progression. No day is ever the same and there are plenty of learning opportunities due to the varied work and client base.
  
Key responsibilities:
  • Preparation and lodgement of ASIC forms
  • Preparation for the client portfolio’s Annual General Meetings and General Meetings
  • Day-to-day management of the Company's Secretarial function and governance matters
  • Maintenance of statutory records for the Group’s entities and all subsidiaries
  • Prepare ASX announcements
  • Preparation of minutes and circular resolutions
  • Preparation of Corporate Governance documents
  • Preparation of Share and Security issues (including performance rights, options and capital markets events such as SPP’s and Rights Issues)
  • Preparation and dispatch of Board papers for the various entities within the client portfolio
  • Ensuring all compliance deadlines are met, internally and externally as per ASX and ASIC requirements including quarterly, semi-annual and annual reports
  • Managing compliance in overseas jurisdictions
  • Attending Board meetings and Committee meetings
  
About you:
  • Graduate in law, commerce or Company governance preferred
  • 5+ years prior company secretariat experience in Australia
  • It is essential you have prior ASX experience
  • Relevant technical knowledge of the Corporations Act (2001)
  • An ability to prioritise, meet deadlines and make sound judgements
Please contact Katie Mitchell for a confidential discussion - katie@pqepartners.com.au
